# RM brief — AL REHMAN WELFARE PROJECT LTD (07987818)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-03 — Pattern of late filing  
**Before an offer:** management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before a facility is offered. The condition stands whatever the overall outcome. (CON-04)  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- AL REHMAN WELFARE PROJECT LTD (company number 07987818) is a private company limited by guarantee without share capital, incorporated on 13 March 2012 under SIC code 99000. Its status on the register is dissolved, which should be resolved before any approach is progressed. `[profile]`
- The register shows 4 active officers out of 5 ever appointed, with no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- There are no charges registered against the company at any time, so it holds a clean security position and a first-charge facility could be offered subject to the remaining policies (SEC-02). `[SEC-02]`
- The most recent accounts were made up to 31 March 2025 and nothing is currently overdue, though that reference date is around 18 months old as at 30 September 2026. `[profile; computed]`
- Two accounts filings in the last three years were late — the 2025 accounts by 3 days and the 2024 accounts by 13 days — which policy treats as a pattern rather than an isolated lapse and drives a REFER (CON-03). `[CON-03; AA filed 2025-12-31; AA filed 2025-01-10]`
- The wider history supports that picture: accounts were filed 84 days late in 2023, 91 days late in 2022 and 136 days late in 2021, with only occasional early filings. `[AA filed 2023-03-22; AA filed 2022-03-29; AA filed 2021-05-13; AA filed 2023-12-22]`
- Because the company files total-exemption accounts, turnover and profit are not on the public record; obtain management accounts covering the most recent 12 months before any facility is offered (CON-04). This is missing information to collect, not an adverse indicator. `[CON-04; profile]`
